# msl_stream (Resource)

Manages an MSL5 **Stream** resource (`/api/v1/streams`). Streams configure live streaming sessions and depend on an Origin.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allowed_ips` (List of String) List of IP addresses or CIDR blocks allowed to ingest. Empty list means unrestricted. Maximum 270 entries.
- `contract_id` (String) Akamai contract ID. Immutable: can only be set during resource creation.
- `cptag` (String) CP code tag. Immutable: can only be set during resource creation.
- `format` (String) Streaming format. One of `HLS`, `CMAF`, `DASH`. Immutable: can only be set during resource creation.
- `group_id` (String) Group identifier for the stream. Updatable in-place.
- `ingest_location` (String) Primary ingest zone (e.g. `US_SEA`). Immutable: can only be set during resource creation.
- `origin_id` (String) ID of the Origin this stream belongs to. Immutable: can only be set during resource creation.

### Optional

- `archiving` (Block List) Archiving configuration. Required — provide exactly one block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--archiving))
- `backup_ingest_location` (String) Optional backup ingest zone. Must differ from `ingest_location`. Immutable: can only be set during resource creation.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the stream.
- `hls_to_llhls` (Block List) HLS-to-LL-HLS conversion configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--hls_to_llhls))
- `ingest_authentication_mode` (String) Ingest authentication mode. One of `NONE`, `DIGEST`, `HEADER`.
- `ingest_header` (Block List) Ingest header authentication configuration. Used when `ingest_authentication_mode` is `HEADER`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--ingest_header))
- `playback` (Block List) Playback configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--playback))
- `playlist_duration_in_min` (Number) DVR window duration in minutes. Use `-1` to follow the encoder, or `0`–`720` for a fixed window.

### Read-Only

- `backup_host_name` (String) Backup encoder hostname assigned by MSL5.
- `backup_origin_host_name` (String) The fully-qualified backup origin hostname.
- `backup_publishing_url` (String) Backup publishing URL for this stream.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of when the stream was created.
- `created_by` (String) The user who created the stream.
- `host_name` (String) Primary encoder hostname assigned by MSL5.
- `id` (String) The unique stream ID assigned by the MSL5 API (`stream_id`).
- `origin_host_name` (String) The fully-qualified origin hostname derived from the linked origin.
- `primary_publishing_url` (String) Primary publishing URL for this stream.
- `status` (String) Current status of the stream (e.g. `READY`).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of the last update.

<a id="nestedblock--archiving"></a>
### Nested Schema for `archiving`

Required:

- `no_archive` (Boolean) When `true`, archiving is disabled. When `false`, `automatic_purge` is required.

Optional:

- `automatic_purge` (Block List) Automatic purge settings. Required when `no_archive` is `false`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--archiving--automatic_purge))

<a id="nestedblock--archiving--automatic_purge"></a>
### Nested Schema for `archiving.automatic_purge`

Required:

- `retention_days` (Number) Number of days to retain archived content (1–62).



<a id="nestedblock--hls_to_llhls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hls_to_llhls`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether HLS-to-LL-HLS conversion is enabled.
- `segment_template` (String) Regex pattern to extract the segment number from segment filenames.


<a id="nestedblock--ingest_header"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ingest_header`

Optional:

- `header` (String) The HTTP header name used for authentication.
- `values` (List of String) Accepted header values.


<a id="nestedblock--playback"></a>
### Nested Schema for `playback`

Optional:

- `akamai_g2o_auth` (Block List) Akamai G2O playback authentication. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--playback--akamai_g2o_auth))

<a id="nestedblock--playback--akamai_g2o_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `playback.akamai_g2o_auth`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether G2O authentication is enabled.
- `g2o_version` (Number) G2O version number.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) G2O secret key. This value is sensitive and will not be shown in logs or plan output.
- `time_delta` (Number) Allowed time delta in seconds for G2O token validation.





## Import

```bash
terraform import msl_stream.primary <stream_id>
```
